description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing weight classes within an OpenCart admin module. It includes methods for listing, viewing, creating, editing, and deleting weight class configurations, with integrated language support, permission checks, and URL generation.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Controller class for managing weight classes in the OpenCart admin panel, providing functionality for listing, creating, editing, and deleting weight classes with appropriate access control and multilingual support.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial entry point; loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumbs, and renders the main weight class list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of weight classes, primarily by invoking getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares paginated list data of weight classes, including URLs, total count, and view rendering.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a weight class, including language descriptions and existing data pre-population.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions to create or update a weight class, including permission validation and data validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected weight classes, with permission and dependency checks.
